# Floyd

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `core` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 14 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Public shop: public pages captured signed out. Signed-in screens were not captured..

Captured 2026-11-22, signed out (public pages only; login, signup, checkout, and subscribe were not followed). Themes: core.

Floyd is a public modular furniture shop at [https://floydhome.com](https://floydhome.com). This package is a signed-out capture on 2026-11-22. Prices on the product page read USD. Desktop width measured 1440 by 900, `devicePixelRatio` 2. The homepage, one public product, and Design Principles were photographed. Nothing was typed, submitted, or signed in.

floyd.com was not opened. That is a different company.

`catalog.json` was left alone. `webapps-manifest.json` was left alone. `login-extracted` was not flipped.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Keep the page cream and the type ink.** The page is `#f8f6ed`. Body type, the wordmark, and Add To Cart are `#231e1e`. [screenshots/home-light-1440.png](screenshots/home-light-1440.png)
- **Use a sky bar for the sale line.** The announcement bar is `#65c3e9`, 65px, ink type. The header under it is cream, 71px. Same shot.
- **Stop before the account host.** Account leaves floydhome.com for a Shopify sign-in URL. The screenshot was discarded. Add To Cart and Subscribe were not clicked. [screenshots/product-light-1440.png](screenshots/product-light-1440.png)
